purpose.zh: 静止蹲住，练大腿和臀部的耐力
purpose.en: Build thigh and glute endurance with a still hold.

text.zh: 背贴墙，大腿和地面平行，膝盖在脚踝上方
text.en: Back on the wall, thighs level, knees over your ankles

text.zh: 双脚与髋同宽，手臂向前伸直。
text.en: Feet hip-width apart, arms reaching forward.
Breathe steadily and do not hold your breath.

commonErrors.en: Letting your knees drift far past your toes.
Letting your back come off the wall.

cautions.zh: 膝盖疼时蹲高一点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your knees hurt, sit higher, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: training=hold（动画是静止靠墙蹲，只有呼吸起伏；批表的 2 次是呼吸）
